proof_body:
by
  intro G _ _ p n m hp hG hm
  haveI : Fact p.Prime := ⟨hp⟩
  refine ⟨card_sylow_modEq_one p G, ?_⟩
  obtain ⟨P⟩ : Nonempty (Sylow p G) := inferInstance
  have hm0 : m ≠ 0 := fun h => hm (h ▸ dvd_zero p)
  have hfac : Nat.factorization (Nat.card G) p = n := by
    rw [hG, Nat.factorization_mul (pow_ne_zero n hp.ne_zero) hm0]
    simp [hp.factorization_self, Nat.factorization_eq_zero_of_not_dvd hm]
  have hcard : Nat.card (P : Subgroup G) = p ^ n := by
    rw [← hfac]
    exact P.card_eq_multiplicity
  have hindex : (P : Subgroup G).index = m := by
    have h := (P : Subgroup G).index_mul_card
    rw [hcard, hG, mul_comm] at h
    exact Nat.eq_of_mul_eq_mul_left (pow_pos hp.pos n) h
  rw [← hindex]
  exact P.card_dvd_index
target_source: ∀ (G : Type*) [Group G] [Finite G] (p n m : ℕ), p.Prime → Nat.card G = p ^ n * m → ¬ p ∣ m → Nat.card (Sylow p G) ≡ 1 [MOD p] ∧ Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ m
